  private async write(
    lines: string[],
    context: Context,
    fromHTTP: boolean,
    identity?: LocalCookieMutationIdentity,
  ): Promise<Outcome> {
    if (this.closed)
      throw new DOMException("Cookie authority is closed", "InvalidStateError");
    if (context.signal?.aborted)
      throw (
        context.signal.reason ||
        new DOMException("Cookie write aborted", "AbortError")
      );
    if (
      !Array.isArray(lines) ||
      lines.length > 128 ||
      lines.some((line) => typeof line !== "string")
    )
      throw new TypeError("Set-Cookie requires separate bounded header lines");
    await this.assertWrite(context.request.origin);
    const db = await this.database;
    if (this.closed)
      throw new DOMException("Cookie authority is closed", "InvalidStateError");
    const outcome = await new Promise<Outcome>((resolve, reject) => {
      const transaction = db.transaction(["cookies", "meta"], "readwrite", {
        durability: "default",
      });
      this.transactions.add(transaction);
      const store = transaction.objectStore("cookies"),
        meta = transaction.objectStore("meta"),
        revision = meta.get("revision"),
        priorIdentity =
          this.localAuthority && identity
            ? meta.get([
                "local-cookie-result-v2",
                identity.binding,
                identity.sequence,
              ])
            : undefined,
        usage = this.localAuthority ? meta.get("local-usage-v2") : undefined,
        requestSite =
          parseDomain(context.request.hostname, { allowPrivateDomains: true })
            .domain || context.request.hostname,
        request = store.index("site").getAll(requestSite);
      let failure: unknown,
        result: Outcome,
        changed = false;
      const abort = () => {
        failure =
          context.signal?.reason ||
          new DOMException("Cookie write aborted", "AbortError");
        try {
          transaction.abort();
        } catch {}
      };
      context.signal?.addEventListener("abort", abort, { once: true });
      request.onsuccess = () => {
        try {
          this.assertWriteCached(context.request.origin);
          if (priorIdentity?.result) {
            result = priorIdentity.result;
            return;
          }
          if (context.signal?.aborted) return abort();
          const now = this.options.now(),
            all = new Map<string, Cookie>();
          const journal: unknown[] = [];
          for (const cookie of request.result as Cookie[]) {
            if (cookie.expires !== null && cookie.expires <= now) {
              if (
                cookie.site ===
                (parseDomain(context.request.hostname, {
                  allowPrivateDomains: true,
                }).domain || context.request.hostname)
              ) {
                store.delete(cookie.id);
                journal.push({ op: "delete", cookie });
                changed = true;
              }
            } else all.set(cookie.id, cookie);
          }
          let accepted = 0;
          const acceptedChanges: { op: "set" | "delete"; cookie: Cookie }[] =
            [];
          const rejected: string[] = [];
          for (const line of lines) {
            const parsed = parseLine(
                line,
                context,
                fromHTTP,
                this.options.browserSessionId,
                now,
              ),
              cookie = parsed.cookie;
            if (!cookie) {
              rejected.push(parsed.reason!);
              continue;
            }
            const previous = all.get(cookie.id);
            if (!fromHTTP && previous?.httpOnly) {
              rejected.push("cookie_httponly_overwrite_denied");
              continue;
            }
            if (
              !secure(context.request) &&
              !cookie.secure &&
              [...all.values()].some(
                (old) =>
                  old.secure &&
                  old.name === cookie.name &&
                  (cookieDomainMatches(old.domain, cookie.domain) ||
                    cookieDomainMatches(cookie.domain, old.domain)) &&
                  cookiePathMatches(cookie.path, old.path),
              )
            ) {
              rejected.push("cookie_secure_overlay_denied");
              continue;
            }
            accepted++;
            if (cookie.expires !== null && cookie.expires <= now) {
              acceptedChanges.push({ op: "delete", cookie });
              if (all.delete(cookie.id)) {
                store.delete(cookie.id);
                journal.push({ op: "delete", cookie });
                changed = true;
              }
              continue;
            }
            if (previous) cookie.created = previous.created;
            if (previous && sameCookieState(previous, cookie)) {
              // Still return/persist the accepted result identity below. An
              // acknowledgement retry cannot later reapply this assignment.
              acceptedChanges.push({ op: "set", cookie: previous });
              continue;
            }
            all.set(cookie.id, cookie);
            acceptedChanges.push({ op: "set", cookie });
            store.put(cookie);
            journal.push({ op: "set", cookie });
            changed = true;
          }
          const perSite = new Map<string, number>();
          const retainedUsage = !changed && usage?.result &&
            Number.isSafeInteger(usage.result.count) && usage.result.count >= 0 &&
            Number.isSafeInteger(usage.result.bytes) && usage.result.bytes >= 0
            ? { count: usage.result.count, bytes: usage.result.bytes }
            : undefined;
          let size = 0;
          for (const cookie of all.values()) {
            perSite.set(cookie.site, (perSite.get(cookie.site) || 0) + 1);
            if (!retainedUsage) size += bytes(JSON.stringify(cookie));
          }
          const previousRows = request.result as Cookie[];
          const aggregate = retainedUsage || (this.localAuthority
            ? {
                count:
                  (usage?.result?.count || 0) - previousRows.length + all.size,
                bytes:
                  (usage?.result?.bytes || 0) -
                  previousRows.reduce(
                    (sum, row) => sum + bytes(JSON.stringify(row)),
                    0,
                  ) +
                  size,
              }
            : { count: all.size, bytes: size });
          if (
            aggregate.count > this.options.maxCookies ||
            aggregate.bytes > this.options.maxBytes ||
            [...perSite.values()].some(
              (count) => count > this.options.maxCookiesPerSite,
            )
          )
            throw new DOMException(
              "Cookie quota exceeded",
              "QuotaExceededError",
            );
          // IDB requests are processed in order: the meta read predates getAll's
          // success task; its result is available before the later write task.
          const version = (revision.result || 0) + (changed ? 1 : 0);
          if (changed) {
            meta.put(version, "revision");
            meta.put(aggregate, "local-usage-v2");
            this.journal(transaction, context.request.origin, journal, version);
          }
          result = {
            accepted,
            rejected,
            revision: version,
            ...(this.localAuthority && identity
              ? { baseRevision: revision.result || 0, acceptedChanges }
              : {}),
          };
          if (this.localAuthority && identity) {
            meta.put(result, [
              "local-cookie-result-v2",
              identity.binding,
              identity.sequence,
            ]);
            if (identity.sequence > 8)
              meta.delete(
                IDBKeyRange.bound(
                  ["local-cookie-result-v2", identity.binding],
                  [
                    "local-cookie-result-v2",
                    identity.binding,
                    identity.sequence - 8,
                  ],
                ),
              );
          }
        } catch (error) {
          failure = error;
          transaction.abort();
        }
      };
      transaction.oncomplete = () => {
        this.transactions.delete(transaction);
        context.signal?.removeEventListener("abort", abort);
        if (changed) {
          this.notify(
            true,
            result.revision,
            identity?.binding.split(":")[0],
            requestSite,
          );
          try {
            this.options.onNativeCommit(context.request.origin);
          } catch {}
        }
        resolve(result!);
      };
      transaction.onabort = () => {
        this.transactions.delete(transaction);
        context.signal?.removeEventListener("abort", abort);
        reject(
          failure ||
            transaction.error ||
            new DOMException("Cookie transaction aborted", "AbortError"),
        );
      };
      transaction.onerror = () => {};
    });
    return outcome;
  }
